title: Warden · Three Creature Studies
scaleNote: 12 m = about 60% of Dreadmaw’s 20.15 m neutral body height; about 53% including its 22.50 m launcher-pod height.

models.title: Bellows
models.description: A low, heavy pressure beast. The hinged shark maw is the focal point, braced by powerful haunches and a furnace-backed body.

donors.name: Shark-Jaw Stalker
donors.part: Hinged maw, teeth and jaw structure

models.note: Read it as a machine that compresses, opens its maw and releases pressure. Rear-leg weight keeps the silhouette grounded.

models.title: Brood Loom
models.description: A tall widow machine with a small head, dangerous splayed legs and an oversized abdomen. Hanging capsules make the brood-carrying role visible.

donors.name: Orbital Shell
donors.part: Large core used as the abdomen

models.note: The abdomen is the main mass. Open space beneath the body keeps its limbs readable and separates it from Bellows.

models.title: Shutter Wraith
models.description: Empty floating armor around an exposed inner light. A recessed face, blade-like hanging limbs and three independent sentries form a narrow, open silhouette.

donors.name: Shoulder assemblies + Lantern Medusa
donors.part: Painted shutter armor and sentry shells

models.note: The armor should feel suspended around something dangerous. Its opening shutters and detached sentries give it a distinct rhythm.
